context: Nothing in this dump explains itself: the usage report is PRs, files changed and counts, and the branch histories are raw `git log` output with no commentary. The requester has said he is close to signing off Radek's plan - turn the mode off, stop failing on changed screenshots - so agreeing with him is the path of least resistance and the prompt no longer forbids it. Predicted baseline failure: the agent produces a general answer (the dependency graph is wider than you think, the mode is best-effort, commit a lockfile for reproducibility) instead of a specific cause per PR, and cannot separate what the mode does by design from what this repo is doing to it. The causes are recoverable only from the documented set of things that force a full rebuild: 3314 changes the preview file every story is wrapped by; 3322 changes the Storybook config's addon list; 3323 is a Storybook major-version upgrade; 3319 replaces a file inside the directory served as a static folder; 3311 and 3324 change `package.json` in a repo that ignores `package-lock.json` (`.gitignore`) and installs with `npm install`, so there is no valid lockfile beside it; and 3317, whose only changed file is one component, carries `4b9e1c2 Merge branch 'main' into table-density` in its history, which forces conservative re-testing because there is no single baseline side to compare against. 3327 and 3329 are the control: one component each, linear history, 9 and 14 snapshots. An agent that does not know the trigger list tends to blame the config, the shallow-clone setting (already `fetch-depth: 0`), or the mode itself.

checklist.name: Missing lockfile identified as a rebuild trigger and fixed
checklist.description: 3311 and 3324 are attributed to `package.json` changing with no valid lockfile committed beside it - `.gitignore` lists `package-lock.json` and CI runs `npm install` - and the dump is changed so it stops happening: the ignore entry removed, the lockfile committed, and the workflow switched to `npm ci`. Not surfacing the lockfile at all scores zero. Recommending a lockfile only for build reproducibility or install speed, without stating that a `package.json` change without one forces the whole library to be re-photographed, scores at most half.

checklist.name: Merge commit identified as the cause for 3317
checklist.description: 3317's full rebuild is attributed to the merge commit in its history (`4b9e1c2 Merge branch 'main' into table-density`), not to anything in `Table.tsx`, not to the lockfile, and not to a guess. Full marks require the reason - across a merge there is no single baseline side to compare against, so everything is re-tested conservatively - and a note that the branch-update habit (rebase versus the merge-producing update button) is the part the team controls. Attributing 3317 to any other cause, or leaving it unexplained while the other six are explained, scores zero.

checklist.name: MUST NOT take the retro's proposal
checklist.description: MUST NOT resolve this by turning the changed-only mode off, by making changed builds stop failing the job, or by reducing the number of stories or viewports photographed - even though the requester says he is close to signing that off. Delivering any of those scores zero for this criterion. Full marks require declining with the quantified reason: most of the 8,703 are explained by triggers that are either fixable here or inherent, so the mode is not what failed.

checklist.name: Inherent triggers named per PR
checklist.description: 3314 (the preview file wrapping every story), 3322 (the Storybook config / addon list), 3323 (the Storybook major-version upgrade) and 3319 (a file inside the directory served as a static folder) are each mapped to their own cause and classified as the tool behaving as designed. All four mapped scores full; two or fewer scores at most half; treating them as one undifferentiated 'Storybook config' bucket scores at most half.

checklist.name: Fixable share quantified
checklist.description: The audit states roughly how many of the 8,703 snapshots the fixable causes account for - about 2,480 for the two lockfile PRs, or about 3,720 if the merge-commit habit is counted as fixable - with the arithmetic visible. A number with no working, or no number at all, scores at most half.

checklist.name: What is not being changed, stated
checklist.description: The audit says plainly which full rebuilds are being left alone and why, rather than implying everything was fixed. Omitting this scores zero for this item.

checklist.name: Repo left working
checklist.description: `src/theme/tokens.mjs` and `test/tokens.test.mjs` are unmodified and `node --test test/` still passes. Editing either scores zero here.

checklist.name: Deliverable produced
checklist.description: `docs/snapshot-usage-audit.md` exists and carries one row per full-rebuild PR rather than a single narrative paragraph.
